recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. If BR&R wants a direct PackagedProductDefinition.operation element or a distinct reusable ManufacturingBusinessOperation resource, that should be handled as a new modeling decision rather than as unfinished FHIR-19727 work.
issue_request: FHIR-19727 asked to externalize MedicinalProduct.manufacturingBusinessOperation so the operation could be referenced from both MedicinalProduct and MedicinalProductPackaged. It is Applied with resolution Persuasive with Modification for R5; BR&R approved a modified model where operation details can be carried by ActivityDefinition/RegulatedAuthorization relationships while simple type/manufacturer data can remain directly on the product.
initial_application: The issue was applied before this reconciliation. Commit e6ec244b21 added MedicinalProductDefinition.manufacturingBusinessOperation.authorization as a RegulatedAuthorization reference, and commit e5ec514c55 completed FHIR-19727 by changing the operation type to allow an ActivityDefinition reference and by moving authorization details out of the product operation structure.
additional_context: The R4-era names have since been normalized: fhir.ini maps current active resources to MedicinalProductDefinition and PackagedProductDefinition, and later FHIR-29708 renamed manufacturingBusinessOperation to operation and manufacturer to organization. Current MedicinalProductDefinition.operation.type is a CodeableReference to ActivityDefinition or PlanDefinition and states that RegulatedAuthorization points to the same plan or activity; RegulatedAuthorization.subject can reference ActivityDefinition, PlanDefinition, MedicinalProductDefinition, and PackagedProductDefinition. PackagedProductDefinition retains direct manufacturer elements for package manufacturer data.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current authoritative source already conveys the approved externalization pattern and does not need a duplicate package operation element to satisfy the modified resolution.

related_jiras.note: Later Published issue/commit renamed manufacturingBusinessOperation to operation and manufacturer to organization, explaining the current element names.
